metadata.name: proove_registry
metadata.description: Proove Artifact Registry: certifies unique artifacts, publishes the commitment root and the verification key of the possession circuit, answers custody checks and records ownership transfers after a sale.

private_context.note: Private context (credentials, session data) never passes to another network or site. Only fields named here may pass.

tools.name: registry_clerk

function.description: Front agent. Answers registry questions (current root, verification key, custody of a nullifier) and records custody transfers. Deterministic: no model is involved, so a registry answer never depends on an LLM.

tools.instructions: Answer from the registry ledger only. Never reveal item secrets. A custody transfer needs the current holder's sale receipt and the registry owner's approval.
